tasks.name: Grid Survey Coverage Sweep 2
tasks.content: Have Wind One take off to 24.2 meters, then fly a rectangular survey grid over the south-west corner (127.2, 454.2), the south-east corner (691.1, 473.9), the north-east corner (731.1, 278.7) and back to the south-west corner, staying at 24.2 meters the whole time. Take a photo as it reaches every waypoint, including the return over the south-west corner, so four photographs in total, and finish hovering above that last waypoint. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.
